I am 68 years old. I finished middle school and I have worked my 4.1 mu in Quzhou County for 50 years. My land grows wheat in the winter half and maize in the summer half. I do not change what works. I watch my neighbors, and if their harvest is good, I do the same.

For wheat, I will rotary till the field once in early October and sow 30 jin of improved seed per mu. The seed dealer sells the same variety Lao Wang plants, so I trust it. Before sowing, I will spread one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu. The bag reads roughly 16-18-6. At jointing time in March, I will topdress with 20 kg of urea per mu. I would rather use a bit extra fertilizer than see my wheat go yellow. I will irrigate three times: the winter water, one when the wheat greens up, and one when the grain is filling. I will spray herbicide once after sowing, insecticide twice, and fungicide once because the rust always comes. Last year my wheat gave me 1000 jin per mu, and this year I expect about 500 kg per mu again.

For maize, I will plant hybrid seed right after wheat harvest in June without tilling. No-tillage saves me diesel and a day of labor. I will plant one bag of hybrid seed per mu, about 2.5 kg. At sowing, I will put down 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu. When the stalks are knee-high, I will spread 15 kg of urea per mu. I will irrigate twice if the summer is dry. I will spray herbicide once and insecticide twice because the corn borers are heavy this year. I expect about 1100 jin per mu, around 550 kg.

My family has three people, and every bag of fertilizer is cash out of my pocket. But losing a crop is a disaster I cannot afford. If I am uncertain, I do exactly what I did last year.
